stress guard fill: elastic_vti keeps a local copy because elastic_bc.h's DW_NDIM==1-only-defensive (void)ny_ cast is a genuine extra statement (elastic_vti never builds at DW_NDIM==1, so ny_ is always used there) that would break preprocessed-token identity if shared; the guard-fill index arithmetic itself is unchanged and must not drift from the shared header's. The two copies are not byte-identical and cannot be: elastic_bc.h also serves elastic.c/elastic_born.c, which build at DW_NDIM==1, so it carries that dimension's parameter guards, #else branch and the (void)ny_ cast that goes with them; elastic_vti is only built for DW_NDIM 2 and 3 (CMakeLists.txt), so its copy omits all of that. expected_delta below freezes exactly those differences and nothing else. Verified equivalent by preprocessing both copies in elastic_vti.c's own translation unit with gcc -E over every built variant (DW_NDIM 2/3 x DW_ACCURACY 2/4/6/8 x float/double x +/-DW_MPML, 32 in all): each variant's token streams are identical apart from elastic_bc.h's extra `(void)ny_;` no-op, so the guard-fill index arithmetic provably matches and must not drift.
